_meta.no_deed_text: No Deed Book Found or Provided
_meta.deed_formats: Illinois recorders index deeds by document (instrument) number; older records by book and page. Seen: year-letter numbers (Adams "2012R-10335", Kane "2010K025226", Bureau "2025R01879"), plain numbers (Lake "7524542", Woodford 1902071, White "20137131"), year-dash numbers (Whiteside "2019-01156", Wayne "2019-0504", Hancock "2009-0281"), book-page in the document field (Knox "3621-346"), and separate Book / Page fields (Lawrence "358" / "250", Jersey book1/page1). The common DevNet wEdge schema carries document_no1 plus owner1_document_book / owner1_document_page.
_meta.plat_formats: No plat book/page field in any selected source.
_meta.excluded_false_hits: Fayette: Fayette County Parcels_Fayette layer 0 (services6 Z4Q9ZsVmYEJy5ct5, edit 2026-07-22) has the owner/deed/PIN schema but returns 0 records; the Sidwell catalog item FayetteILFeatures no longer exists (Invalid URL).; Crawford: Crawford, Jasper and Wabash search hits were the Indiana statewide parcel layer (IGIO), not Illinois.; Union: gis.unionco.org is Union County, North Carolina (not Illinois).; Winnebago: NorthParkWater Parcels is a water-district utility layer with no owner names.; Cook: Cook County parcelHistorical / cookVwrDynmc parcel layers carry PIN only; their Name field is the PIN, not an owner.; Macon: Macon County Parcels2021 layer 1 Name field is the PIN (parcel fabric record name), not an owner.; gis.adamscounty.org, gis.calhouncounty.org and maps.mercercounty.org are same-name counties in other states.

status_legend.ok: owner+deed+PID live-verified countywide, deed reference filled on at least 50% of parcels
status_legend.partial: owner+PID with no deed, deed under 50%, deed share estimated, or partial-area copy
status_legend.missing: no public countywide ArcGIS owner source found (no statewide fallback in Illinois)
